business_type_note: Real estate developer treated as 'Operating with a real-estate/NAV overlay' (not a pure REIT): Real Estate development ~80% of revenue, Leasing/Retail malls ~15%, Hospitality ~5%, plus a listed development subsidiary (Emaar Development PJSC) and a disclosed third-party NAV ~AED 247bn. Primary methods are EV/EBITDA, P/E, FCFF DCF, with NAV + SOTP as the real-estate/holding-company cross-checks. NOT a holding company on the Method Map. See 00_valuation-data-triage.md, 'Business-type note'.

discount_rate.wacc_note: 0.105 (10.5%) is the WACC actually USED in the base DCF, the sensitivity grid, and the reverse-DCF (04_intrinsic-dcf.md §3) — a disclosed +0.9pp override above the CAPM-computed 0.096 (9.60%), justified because the 8.5% debt weight understates the net-cash balance sheet and a single-city Dubai cycle warrants a premium. wacc_computed carries the pre-override CAPM/cost-of-debt blend for reference; all published fair values (methods.dcf=18.0, scenario levels) were generated with 0.105, not 0.096.
